MG/Water/Attacker/Burst III, 40 s burst CD, 300-round belt, hitsPerShot 1. Skill 1: a 60-normal-hit counter drives (a) a boss-side Damage Taken ▲ 12.56% / 3 s debuff plus a 158.43%-of-final-ATK rider, and (b) a self partial reload of 20 rounds. Skill 2: a 60-CORE-hit 109.64% rider (encoded as a normal-hit count via an assumed core rate — see caveats), plus a self Critical Rate ▲ 14.6% / 10 s on Full Burst ENTRY (team FB-enter as the text states, NOT own-burst-gated). Burst: self ATK ▲ 62.54% / 10 s and Reload Speed ▲ 67.2% / 20 s — the reload buff is modeled because reload speed gates shots fired and is therefore damage, and its 20 s duration deliberately outlasts the 10 s ATK window. Crit Rate is unscoped in the prose ('Critical Rate ▲'), so it is generic critRatePct, not critRateNormalPct. Nothing in the kit is skipped: all three unmodeled arrays are empty. No Pierce, no elemental-advantage damage buff (Water vs a Fire boss is the clean ×1.10), no stacks, no weapon swap, no DoT, no heal/shield, no gauge manipulation, no burst-eligibility change.

flags.estimate: 200 normal hits (kit trigger is 60 CORE hits; 60 ÷ 0.30 assumed MG core rate)
flags.reasoning: The schema has hitCount (all hits) but no core-hit counter, so a core-hit threshold can only be expressed as an equivalent normal-hit count divided by the core rate. The core rate is measured-only (ALWAYS-⚑ #7, Hit-Rate→core magnitude) and I am blind to it; 0.30 is a mid-band MG guess, nothing more. This value is directly proportional to the rider's fire count, so it is the single largest uncertainty in this override: a 0.20 rate ⇒ 300, a 0.45 rate ⇒ 133, i.e. the rider's total contribution spans a >2× range.

Independent cross-check: count 'CORE HIT' popups per 300-round belt in footage — 60 core hits should land roughly once per (200/shotsPerSec) seconds.
